* A [[curfew]] is imposed in [[Beirut]] after [[Beirut Arab University shooting|deadly clashes]] erupted between pro-government supporters and [[Hezbollah]]-led factions. [http://www.cnn.com/2007/WORLD/meast/01/25/lebanon.protests/index.html (CNN)]
* 276 passengers and 28 crew onboard the [[Cunard Line]]'s [[RMS Queen Elizabeth 2|RMS ''Queen Elizabeth 2'']] are sickened by the [[Norwalk virus group|norovirus]] during its 2007 [[circumnavigation]] of the world. [http://www.cnn.com/2007/HEALTH/01/24/cruiseship.outbreak.ap/index.html (CNN)] [http://www.timesonline.co.uk/article/0,,3-2566183,00.html (The Times)]
* [[Oleg Khinsagov]] is sentenced to 8.5 years imprisonment for smuggling [[highly enriched uranium]] from [[Russia]] to [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2007/01/25/world/europe/25nuke.html?_r=1&ref=europe&pagewanted=all (The New York Times)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20070506120322/http://today.reuters.co.uk/news/articlenews.aspx?type=worldNews (Reuters)]
* Thirty-three people are killed when a bus plunges down a ravine near [[Huautla de Jiménez]] in the north of the [[Mexico|Mexican]] state of [[Oaxaca]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20070922074156/http://www.theaustralian.news.com.au/story/0,20867,21116471-23109,00.html (The Australian)] [http://www.eluniversal.com.mx/notas/402572.html (El Universal)]
* An earthquake measuring 6.2 [[moment magnitude scale|M<sub>w</sub>]] strikes [[Taiwan|Taiwan's]] east coast. There is no report of damage or injuries. [http://www.signonsandiego.com/news/world/20070125-0320-taiwan-earthquake.html (San Diego Union-Tribune)]
